description:
This is a proposal to reinstate a roof terrace which was taken down to install a new flat roof below it earlier this year (2026). The terrace would be replaced like-for-like. It appears on the HM Land Registry Lease documents for the property, dated 4th November 2002. I own and occupy the property. The terrace had been in place for over 20 years before being taken down to facilitate maintenance to the roof below. 

The roof terrace would be installed at the rear of the property and would measure 285cm x 365cm. It would consist of wooden decking, wooden posts and wooden trellis. The builder who would install the terrace it is the same one who removed it and is a Which? Trusted Trader. On his quote document which I can also attach he gives the description of the work as being: "Install a timber frame and joists on pedestal risers, Install decking, posts and trellis".

I'm ticking the option "no" for change of use since it is demarcated as being a roof terrace in the land registry document noted above. The work has not started yet but is scheduled to take place in August 2026.
